parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  t.id,
  t.title,
  t.description,
  t.due_date,
  t.priority,
  t.status,
  t.work_group,
  u.id as assignee_id,
  u.email as assignee_email,
  u.full_name as assignee_name,
  u.username as assignee_username,
  CASE 
    WHEN t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'overdue'
    WHEN t.due_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'due_today'
    WHEN t.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 'due_1_day'
    WHEN t.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '3 days' THEN 'due_3_days'
    ELSE 'due_soon'
  END as urgency_level,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (t.due_date - CURRENT_DATE)) as days_until_due
FROM work_tasks t
LEFT JOIN work_tasks_assigned_to wta ON t.id = wta.worktask_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON wta.user_id = u.id
WHERE t.is_active = true
  AND t.status IN ('chua_bat_dau', 'dang_tien_hanh')
  AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '3 days'
    OR t.due_date = CURRENT_DATE
  )
ORDER BY t.due_date ASC, t.priority DESC

=SELECT log_workflow_execution('{{ $node["Format Task Data"].json.workflow_name }}', '{{ $node["Format Task Data"].json.execution_id }}', 'Send Notifications', 'notification', 'success', '{{ JSON.stringify({total_tasks: $node["Format Task Data"].json.totalTasks, overdue: $node["Format Task Data"].json.overdueCount}) }}'::jsonb, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) as log_id
